metrics.name: csf_sessions
metrics.definition: Agent sessions this host holds, by phase (starting, running, open, canceling, canceled, failed, closed), read from the session service at each scrape.

metrics.name: csf_session_turns_total
metrics.definition: Turns finished: the result records in each run's events.jsonl.

metrics.name: csf_tokens_total
metrics.definition: Tokens by kind (uncached, cache_write, cache_read, output), summed over the per-turn usage of each run's result records.

metrics.name: csf_cost_usd_total
metrics.definition: Executor-reported spend in US dollars: total_cost_usd is cumulative within one executor process, so each result record adds its rise over the previous one, or its whole value after the process restarted.

metrics.name: csf_admission_worker_cap
metrics.definition: Sessions the host admits at once, max(1, floor(cores - 1-minute load)), from the harness launch check.

metrics.name: csf_admission_free_disk_bytes
metrics.definition: Free bytes on the state directory's filesystem, from the harness launch check.

metrics.name: csf_admission_disk_floor_bytes
metrics.definition: Free-disk floor of the harness launch check: twice the largest run directory.

metrics.name: csf_admission_held
metrics.definition: 1 while housekeeping holds session admission, otherwise 0.

metrics.name: csf_host_pressure_some_avg10
metrics.definition: Percent of the last 10 s in which some task waited for the resource (cpu, memory or io), from the kernel's pressure stall information.

metrics.name: csf_resumes_held
metrics.definition: Open runs the last restart still holds because the launch check does not admit them, from the resume queue.

metrics.name: csf_dispatch_slices
metrics.definition: Slices in the dispatcher's snapshot by state: queued, held and running.

metrics.name: csf_dispatch_limit_remaining
metrics.definition: Launches each bounded dispatch limit (harness, budget, rate) still allows, from the dispatcher's snapshot.

metrics.name: csf_dispatch_stage_slices
metrics.definition: Slices in each stage of the line, from the dispatcher's snapshot: ready, blocked, contended, running, merged, failed, canceled.

metrics.name: csf_dispatch_stage_age_seconds
metrics.definition: Seconds the oldest slice in each stage has stood there since its state last moved, from the dispatcher's snapshot.

metrics.name: csf_dispatch_lead_time_seconds
metrics.definition: Mean seconds from enqueue to merge of the slices merged in the last day, from the dispatcher's snapshot; absent when none merged.

metrics.name: csf_gate_decisions_total
metrics.definition: Session gate decisions recorded in each run's events.jsonl, by gate (wait, ready, commit, reply) and decision.

metrics.name: csf_reply_gate_refusals_total
metrics.definition: Replies the reply gate refused, counted once for each rule the refusal names (research_check, commitment).

metrics.name: csf_struggle_rate_per_1k_tool_calls
metrics.definition: Struggle episodes (tool errors, permission denials, retries) per 1,000 tool calls over the current week or day of every run's events.jsonl (ouroboros.Struggles), with its 95% Garwood interval as bound low and high.

metrics.name: csf_compounding_factor
metrics.definition: Per-period factor of the struggle rate: exp of the struggle-weighted log-linear slope over the periods with at least one struggle and 200 tool calls, with its 95% interval; below 1 is improvement, and it needs 3 such periods.

metrics.name: csf_harness_cache_hit_ratio
metrics.definition: Share of submitted input tokens read from the prompt cache.

metrics.name: csf_harness_cache_creation_tokens
metrics.definition: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

metrics.name: csf_harness_cache_sessions
metrics.definition: Virtual and real sessions measured.

metrics.name: csf_harness_cache_first_turn_creation_share
metrics.definition: Share of cache creation paid by first turns.

metrics.name: csf_harness_routing_decisions
metrics.definition: Routing decisions recorded, by arm and reason.

metrics.name: csf_merges_total
metrics.definition: Pull requests merged into main, from GitHub's list of merged pull requests; slice is the title's leading slice name.

metrics.name: csf_ontology_alignment_score
metrics.definition: Ontology alignment score after the latest merged pull request whose body reports one (the after value of its Ontology score line); lower is better.

metrics.name: csf_ontology_alignment_signal
metrics.definition: Count of each ontology alignment signal after the latest merged pull request whose body reports the signal table.

metrics.name: csf_operator_corrections_total
metrics.definition: Operator corrections: distinct mistakes the operator flagged, by class; source hand_labeled is the hand-labeled window in corrections.json, classed by the ticket or gate that owns the class; source affect is every correction pkg/affect reads, classed by its failure code (#417) once the ouroboros codes verb has coded it and uncoded until then.

metrics.name: csf_operator_attention_hours_total
metrics.definition: Operator-attention hours: distinct UTC hours holding at least one operator-authored message, from the runs' send records (source runs) or hand-counted for the corrections.json window (source hand_labeled).

metrics.name: csf_harness_questions_total
metrics.definition: Questions agents put to the operator, by the gate that judged them, their class and verdict.

metrics.name: csf_harness_question_overrides_total
metrics.definition: Sends by which the operator said they wanted a question the question gate refused.

metrics.name: csf_rulings_in_force
metrics.definition: Operator rulings in force, from the harness's ruling records, by whether a gate enforces them (enforced) or none does (unenforced).

metrics.name: csf_hypervisor_cost_events_total
metrics.definition: Hypervisor cost events (#353): one per session operation (warm or cold turn, bind, rebind, model flip, idle close, reopen, keep-alive), derived from every run's records by services/harness/costs, by operation.

metrics.name: csf_hypervisor_cost_usd_total
metrics.definition: US dollars the hypervisor cost events (#353) price, at the per-model prices services/harness/costs fits from the record, by operation.

metrics.name: csf_information_density
metrics.definition: Information density of a session's turns; no samples until slice #348 lands.

metrics.name: csf_merge_checks_total
metrics.definition: Ready and merge control actions on sessions, each of which runs the merge path's checks, by outcome (ok, failed), from each run's events.jsonl.

metrics.name: csf_bazel_build_wall_seconds
metrics.definition: Median wall seconds of a clean Bazel build of the Go tree by arm (A is the defaults), from BAZEL-RAM's lab entry docs/lab/2026-10-05-bazel-ram.md as lab.json records it.

metrics.name: csf_bazel_peak_memory_bytes
metrics.definition: Median peak memory of a clean Bazel build of the Go tree by arm (A is the defaults), from BAZEL-RAM's lab entry docs/lab/2026-10-05-bazel-ram.md as lab.json records it.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_spend_usd_total
metrics.definition: Spend of every cloud job in the record, in dollars; its rate is spend per hour.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_spend_today_usd
metrics.definition: Spend of the cloud jobs created today (UTC), in dollars.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_daily_cap_usd
metrics.definition: The day's cap on cloud spend, in dollars.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_jobs_running
metrics.definition: Cloud jobs that may still be spending.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_job_spend_usd
metrics.definition: One cloud job's spend so far, in dollars.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_job_cap_usd
metrics.definition: One cloud job's cap, in dollars.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_burst_sessions_total
metrics.definition: Fixer sessions launched in burst jobs.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_burst_pull_requests_merged_total
metrics.definition: Pull requests merged from ended burst jobs.

metrics.name: csf_cloud_burst_spend_usd_total
metrics.definition: Spend of ended burst jobs whose merged pull requests are counted, in dollars: the denominator of pull requests per dollar.

metrics.name: csf_chat_settle_seconds
metrics.definition: Seconds from an event log record's timestamp to a connected chat page's live session accepting it, per record: how long a session's event takes to reach its transcript.

metrics.name: csf_github_deliveries_total
metrics.definition: GitHub webhook deliveries this host's receiver answered since it started, by outcome (accepted, duplicate, ignored, refused, failed) and, for a refused one, why.

metrics.name: csf_github_events_total
metrics.definition: Typed GitHub events this host's receiver recorded on the GitHub event stream since it started, by kind.

metrics.name: csf_github_event_latency_seconds
metrics.definition: Seconds from when GitHub says the latest event of each kind happened to when this host recorded it as a typed event.

metrics.name: csf_eval_struggle_rate_per_1k_tool_calls
metrics.definition: A csf build's score on the held-out evaluation suite: struggle episodes per 1,000 tool calls over its replays at the suite's budget, with the 95% Garwood interval as bound low and high.

metrics.name: csf_eval_score_wall_seconds
metrics.definition: Wall-clock seconds to score a build: from the first replay launched to the last recorded.

metrics.name: csf_eval_score_cost_usd
metrics.definition: Dollars to score a build: the model cost of its replays.

metrics.name: csf_eval_shards
metrics.definition: Replays of a build's score run on each node kind: this host or a cloud burst job.
